summary: Frontend-only verification of iter32 Dashboard surgical changes. All 3 target changes verified: (1) Ambient background — exactly 35 gold-tinted particle View elements (hex/rgb of #FFD700/#FFC300/#FFE566/#FFAA00) rendered as descendants of the ambient container, and exactly 4 large blurred orb layers behind content. (2) StatTile now accepts optional `items` prop; with the current 0-shipment dataset the code path correctly HIDES stat-Delivered-list / stat-In Transit-list / stat-Pending-list nodes; JSX shape confirmed by code inspection to render rows when items exist (line1 = consignment_no, line2 = date/direction/weight per spec, muted rgba(255,255,255,0.60), 11–12px). (3) Bangkok Warehouse widget confirmed outside dash-carousel container (DOM parent-chain walk returned false). Carousel contains EXACTLY 3 pages (dash-carousel-page-0/1/2), no page-3; EXACTLY 3 dots (dash-carousel-dot-0/1/2), no dot-3; stat-Delivered is inside page-0, stat-In Transit inside page-1, stat-Pending inside page-2. Programmatic scroll (scrollLeft=1000) correctly activated dot index 2 (width jumped from 7px to 20px). Row 1 (ledger-get-card + ledger-give-card side by side) is unchanged. Other tabs (Shipments/Invoices/Trips/More) render without regression and zero console errors observed post-login.
